title: ABBA after 40 years – level 1
paragraphs: ABBA sang a song in 1974. The band won a big prize. That was 40 years ago. One half of ABBA celebrates the anniversary now.
A lot of people know ABBA. The members of ABBA are famous for their hits. However, it is not fast to make a hit. It takes some time. ABBA did not have a hit after hit after hit.
Bjorn and Frida are two members of ABBA. They celebrate. People sing Happy Birthday for them.
You can read the original story and watch the video in the Level 3 section.
